Description: Initial release containing reconstructed anatomical and MR-Eye-Track MRI, eye-tracking measurements, masks, calibration arrays and sequence definitions for the 50-participant main cohort and two pilot-only participants. Main-cohort images use sub-XXXX/anat/; pilot images use sub-pilotNN/ses-NN/anat/. Main-cohort scanner DAT archives are not included in this release; a later version is planned after header de-identification and verified recompression. The 13 sanitized pilot DAT archives and available VIBE DICOM references are included under sourcedata/sub-pilotNN/ses-NN/rawdata/. Main-cohort ET exports use sourcedata/sub-XXXX/et/; pilot exports use the corresponding participant/session et/ folders. Associated EDF release copies, masks and calibration arrays are under derivatives/. Of 153 ET exports, 152 are complete and the main-cohort 0038 Track export is partial.
